$comment: Manipulating Mastermind (OS Rune model; was Alakazam until 2026-11, wiki 2026-11) with GAME_BREAKDOWN §13's Pokémon twist. Psychic = our ball grab (no OS equivalent: short hold, slowed, any hit drops it; throw ≤ 1.2× Strike). Hyperspace Hole (2026-11 rework, replaces Teleport = Shadow Swap): a portal projectile that chips the first enemy (LIGHT hit), then Hoopa blinks to where it stopped and bursts 0.35 s later (the old pillar's core KB, ~80 % of its damage); evading in that window dodges the burst. Future Sight = Rune's Banish (40 s, 1.75 s banish, 270+130 % dmg) delivered as a delayed area that locks onto an enemy and follows them at 300/s (2026-11 pass 2: a fixed area was walked out of, 0.4 hits a game); Evade dodges it. Player knockback = OS × 1.875; power % → powerRatio.

moves.name: Psychic
moves.desc: Grab the ball from up to 300 away and hold it for 0.6 s (slowed; any hit drops it). Press again to throw it. If you don't, it's tossed forward.

moves.name: Hyperspace Hole
moves.desc: Fling a portal that chips the first enemy it touches. Where it stops, you come out 0.35 s later with a burst. Evade to dodge the burst.

moves.name: Future Sight
moves.desc: Foresee an enemy near where you aim. The mark follows them, and after 1 s it erupts, banishing enemies inside for 1.75 s and blasting the ball. Evade to dodge it.
